mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 49 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Public Library under a waxing gibbous moon. Keep an eye out for the ISS tonight at 4:59 AM as it travels from Mount Horeb toward the Madison area, visible about halfway up the sky.

The Verona Senior Center is offering flexible daily meal options for anyone interested, with orders due by the previous Wednesday. Also, the city is reminding residents about the Mark Drive reconstruction project where utility work is finished and concrete work is currently underway.

Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market on Saturday.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported, and the case remains under investigation.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The restaurant will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
